checklist.item: ParkNYC app receipt showing payment at 11:52 AM for 2 hours
checklist.why: This is the strongest proof. It shows parking was paid through 1:52 PM, which covers the 12:10 PM ticket time. Check that the receipt shows plate GCR 4471 and the zone number for W 45 St & 6 Ave.

checklist.item: Photo of the meter with a blank screen
checklist.why: Shows the meter was broken, which explains why there is no paper receipt from the meter. It is stronger if the photo has a date and time.
Proves the broken meter is the one at this block and links it to the ParkNYC zone. If you can't get it, describe where the meter stands instead.

checklist.item: 311 complaint number for the broken meter
checklist.why: An official record that the meter was reported broken that day backs up the photo. Look in the 311 app or your email for a confirmation. If you can't find one, leave it out. Don't claim a report you can't show.

sentences.text: I am contesting parking ticket 4483 920 117, issued on October 1, 2026 at 12:10 PM at W 45 St & 6 Ave in Manhattan to my commercial vehicle, plate GCR 4471, for parking in a commercial meter zone without a paid receipt.
When I parked, the meter on 45th Street was not working and its screen was blank, as my attached photo shows.
Because the meter could not print a receipt, I paid for parking through the ParkNYC app at 11:52 AM for two hours.
My attached ParkNYC receipt shows that my parking was paid until 1:52 PM, so my vehicle was legally paid for when the ticket was written at 12:10 PM.
I respectfully ask that this ticket be dismissed.
